faqs.segments_allow_grouping_users_by_specifi: Segments allow grouping users by specific criteria to help tailor interactions and content. faqs.how_do_i_create_a_new_segment_148780bc: How do I create a new segment?

faqs.yes_you_can_automate_segment_updates_by_: Yes, you can automate segment updates by setting your criteria to refresh regularly. faqs.can_i_combine_multiple_criteria_for_a_se: Can I combine multiple criteria for a segment?

faqs.how_often_should_i_update_my_segments_62: How often should I update my segments?

faqs.yes_you_can_include_custom_attributes_in: Yes, you can include custom attributes in your segments, allowing you to create highly tailored groups. Custom attributes can include specific interests, preferences, or actions unique to your audience and brand.
faqs.can_i_exclude_certain_users_from_a_segme: Can I exclude certain users from a segment?
faqs.yes_you_can_exclude_specific_users_or_gr: Yes, you can exclude specific users or groups of users from any segment by setting exclusion criteria. faqs.dynamic_segmentation_is_a_powerful_featu: Dynamic segmentation is a powerful feature that automatically updates segments in real-time based on user behavior or profile changes. As users interact with your platform or new data is collected, they are automatically added or removed from relevant segments. faqs.how_do_i_update_my_billing_information_2: How do I update my billing information?
faqs.to_update_your_billing_information_go_to: To update your billing information, go to the Billing section in your account settings and click on “Update Info.” Modify your payment method, address, and other billing details. Make sure your billing details are up-to-date for a seamless payment experience.
faqs.yes_invoices_can_be_downloaded_from_the_: Yes, invoices can be downloaded from the Billing section. Simply find the invoice and click "Download" to save it to your device for your records.
faqs.yes_billing_reminders_are_sent_7_days_be: Yes, billing reminders are sent 7 days before payment due dates. The reminder includes a summary of the amount due and the payment date. By being proactive with reminders, we help ensure you don’t miss important payment deadlines, giving you enough time to resolve any billing issues that may arise. The reminder also contains instructions on how to update your payment details if needed to avoid any disruptions to your service.
faqs.what_happens_if_a_payment_fails_3b5c45a1: What happens if a payment fails?
faqs.if_a_payment_fails_you_will_receive_an_i:
If a payment fails, you will receive an immediate email notification and see an alert on your account page. The alert provides details on why the payment failed (such as insufficient funds, expired card, or other issues) and offers a link to retry the payment. We allow you a grace period of up to 7 days to resolve the issue. During this time, you can update your payment information or contact your bank to ensure that funds are available.

Additionally, we may attempt to process the payment again automatically after a few days if the failure was due to a temporary issue, such as a network disruption or a brief system error. If the payment issue persists beyond the grace period, your account may be temporarily suspended until the issue is resolved. We will also notify you of any late fees that may apply if the payment remains unresolved. Please ensure that your payment details are up to date to avoid any service disruptions. If you need assistance, our customer support team is available to help you resolve any payment problems.
faqs.yes_auto_renewal_is_available_for_all_pl:
Yes, auto-renewal is available for all plans. To enable auto-renewal, visit your Billing section and check the option for automatic renewal. This ensures that your subscription is renewed automatically using the payment method stored in your account. The auto-renewal process begins at the end of each billing cycle, preventing service interruptions and making sure you don’t miss out on any features. If you want to disable auto-renewal at any time, you can easily do so by updating your subscription settings in the Billing section. You’ll still have access to your service until the end of the current billing period, and once the period ends, you will no longer be charged, and your account will be downgraded or suspended according to your plan’s terms.

Auto-renewal provides convenience and saves you time, so you don’t have to manually renew your subscription each time. Your account will remain active without needing to remember renewal dates. Additionally, auto-renewal guarantees that you will continue receiving any updates, new features, or improvements to the service as they are rolled out. If you have any questions or concerns about the renewal process, our support team is available to assist and clarify any details.
faqs.how_can_i_view_my_billing_history_603337: How can I view my billing history?

faqs.how_do_i_apply_a_discount_code_1fcd026d: How do I apply a discount code?

If the discount is successfully applied, the final amount will be updated to include the savings.

Discount codes are typically given during promotional periods or as part of special offers. If you experience any issues with applying your discount code, feel free to contact customer support for assistance. They can ensure the code is valid and applied correctly. In some cases, discount codes may have expiration dates or restrictions, so make sure to use them before the code expires. If your code doesn’t work, double-check that you’ve entered it correctly and that it meets all the applicable terms and conditions. Should you need more details, our team is always ready to help clarify any concerns or questions you might have about using discount codes.
faqs.how_do_i_reset_my_password_644ffa3e: How do I reset my password?

Make sure your new password is unique and secure to keep your account safe. A strong password typically includes a combination of upper and lower case letters, numbers, and symbols.
faqs.yes_you_can_create_multiple_accounts_but: Yes, you can create multiple accounts, but each account requires a unique email address. Each account will have its own settings, billing details, saved preferences, and login credentials. Make sure to keep track of your login details for each account to avoid confusion. Having multiple accounts can help you organize your data and access different features tailored to specific needs. Additionally, each account will remain separate, ensuring that changes or updates to one account will not affect the other.
faqs.how_do_i_delete_my_account_33e3b64a: How do I delete my account?
faqs.to_delete_your_account_navigate_to_the_a:
To delete your account, navigate to the account settings page and click on the “Delete Account” option. You may be prompted to confirm this action, as deleting your account is irreversible. Once confirmed, all your account information, including settings, preferences, and any saved data, will be permanently removed from our system. It’s important to back up any critical data or information before proceeding, as deletion is final, and data cannot be recovered. We recommend exporting any relevant files, such as transaction history, documents, or messages, before you confirm the deletion.

Once your account is deleted, there will be no way to retrieve it or its contents. If you're unsure about deleting your account, you may want to consider deactivating it temporarily instead, which allows you to preserve your data for future use. In the event you change your mind later, deactivation offers a way to re-enable the account without losing any of your stored information. However, deletion is a permanent step and should be taken with careful consideration. Please make sure to review all implications of account deletion before proceeding.
faqs.can_i_change_my_email_address_d25de7da: Can I change my email address?
faqs.yes_you_can_change_your_email_address_fr:
Yes, you can change your email address from the account settings section. Simply go to the “Email” field, enter your new email address, and click “Save” to confirm the change. A confirmation email will be sent to your new email address to verify it. Once you confirm the email, it will become your primary login credential, and you’ll need to use it for future logins. It’s important to make sure the new email address is one that you frequently check for updates and notifications. By updating your email, you ensure that you will continue to receive account notifications, billing information, and other important messages.

Remember, if you ever need to change your email again, the process is simple and can be done directly from the settings page. Having an up-to-date email address is crucial to ensure you're always informed about changes to your account or important alerts, such as payment reminders, service updates, or security notifications. If you encounter any issues when updating your email, our support team is available to assist you with the process and ensure everything goes smoothly.
faqs.yes_two_factor_authentication_2fa_is_ava:
Yes, two-factor authentication (2FA) is available and can be enabled from your account’s security settings. 2FA adds an additional layer of security by requiring a second form of verification, typically sent to your mobile device, in addition to your regular password. This greatly reduces the risk of unauthorized access to your account. Even if someone else manages to obtain your password, they won’t be able to log in without the second authentication factor. It’s an important step in securing your personal information and protecting your account from potential threats.

To enable 2FA, go to your account settings and select the security tab, where you’ll find the option to activate two-factor authentication. Once enabled, you’ll be prompted to enter a code sent to your mobile device each time you log in, providing extra protection. We recommend enabling 2FA for all accounts to help prevent unauthorized access and enhance your online security. It’s a quick setup that ensures your account stays safe from hackers, providing you with peace of mind knowing that your personal information is secure.

With segmentation, you can ensure personalized experiences and targeted communication, maximizing engagement by delivering content that resonates with each segment’s unique characteristics and preferences.
faqs.how_do_i_create_a_new_segment_148780bc: How do I create a new segment?
faqs.to_create_a_new_segment_click_on_the_cre: To create a new segment, click on the “Create Segment” option in the dashboard. From there, you can define specific criteria that users must meet to be included in the segment. These criteria may include demographics like age or location, behaviors such as browsing patterns or purchase history, or even custom fields you've defined. Once you've saved the segment, the system will automatically populate it based on your selected criteria. You can continue to refine the segment as needed, adding or adjusting filters for optimal targeting, ensuring your campaigns reach the right audience with maximum relevance and effectiveness.
faqs.yes_you_can_automate_segment_updates_by_: Yes, you can automate segment updates by setting your criteria to refresh regularly. This ensures that users are always grouped according to the latest data, without manual updates. Automated updates allow your segments to stay dynamic, adjusting in real time to user activity or profile changes.
faqs.what_data_can_be_used_for_segmentation_a: What data can be used for segmentation?
faqs.you_can_use_a_wide_variety_of_data_for_s: You can use a wide variety of data for segmentation, including demographic information like age and location, behavior metrics such as purchase frequency and engagement level, and custom attributes tailored to your business needs. Additionally, segmentation can be based on user preferences, interests, and lifecycle stage, allowing you to target groups with personalized content based on real, relevant criteria.
faqs.is_there_a_limit_to_the_number_of_segmen: Is there a limit to the number of segments?
faqs.no_our_system_allows_you_to_create_unlim: No, our system allows you to create unlimited segments, giving you complete flexibility in organizing your audience. Whether you need a few broad segments or dozens of highly specific ones, you can adapt your strategy to suit your goals. This unlimited capacity is ideal for businesses with complex audiences who need to tailor their messaging across multiple user personas or lifecycle stages.
faqs.can_i_combine_multiple_criteria_for_a_se: Can I combine multiple criteria for a segment?
faqs.yes_you_can_combine_multiple_criteria_wh:
Yes, you can combine multiple criteria when defining a segment, offering the flexibility to create complex and highly refined audience targeting. For instance, you could define a segment for users aged 18-35 who have made a purchase in the last month or create a segment targeting users in specific geographic regions who have shown interest in particular product categories. This allows you to layer demographic, behavioral, and even custom field criteria for a more nuanced approach.

The ability to fine-tune these segments ensures that your communications are tailored and relevant, enabling you to engage with each group based on their unique behaviors, preferences, and characteristics. This level of customization enhances the impact of your campaigns, ensuring better response rates and conversions.
faqs.how_often_should_i_update_my_segments_62: How often should I update my segments?
faqs.the_frequency_of_updating_your_segments_: The frequency of updating your segments depends on your data freshness requirements. For instance, if you’re targeting highly dynamic behaviors, such as recent purchase activity, automated daily updates might be ideal. However, for more static criteria like age or location, updates can be less frequent. Regularly updating ensures that your messages reach the right audience, maximizing engagement and relevance.
faqs.yes_you_can_include_custom_attributes_in: Yes, you can include custom attributes in your segments, allowing you to create highly tailored groups. Custom attributes can include specific interests, preferences, or actions unique to your audience and brand.
faqs.can_i_exclude_certain_users_from_a_segme: Can I exclude certain users from a segment?
faqs.yes_you_can_exclude_specific_users_or_gr: Yes, you can exclude specific users or groups of users from any segment by setting exclusion criteria. This is useful when you want to target a broad audience but avoid certain subsets. For instance, you might target users interested in a product category but exclude those who already purchased within a specific time. Exclusion criteria ensure that segments remain relevant and don’t overlap unnecessarily.
faqs.dynamic_segmentation_is_a_powerful_featu: Dynamic segmentation is a powerful feature that automatically updates segments in real-time based on user behavior or profile changes. As users interact with your platform or new data is collected, they are automatically added or removed from relevant segments. This ensures your audience is always accurately represented, reflecting their most recent actions, preferences, or behaviors. Dynamic segments are especially useful for real-time marketing, like cart abandonment campaigns, where timely and relevant communication is key to improving engagement and conversions.
faqs.how_do_i_update_my_billing_information_2: How do I update my billing information?
faqs.to_update_your_billing_information_go_to: To update your billing information, go to the Billing section in your account settings and click on “Update Info.” Modify your payment method, address, and other billing details. Ensure accuracy to avoid payment interruptions. After updating, save your changes to ensure they are applied to future payments and invoices. Make sure your billing details are up-to-date for a seamless payment experience.
faqs.yes_invoices_can_be_downloaded_from_the_: Yes, invoices can be downloaded from the Billing section. Simply find the invoice and click "Download" to save it to your device for your records.
faqs.yes_billing_reminders_are_sent_7_days_be: Yes, billing reminders are sent 7 days before payment due dates. The reminder includes a summary of the amount due and the payment date. This allows you to prepare in advance. You’ll receive a notification both via email and in your account dashboard. By being proactive with reminders, we help ensure you don’t miss important payment deadlines, giving you enough time to resolve any billing issues that may arise. The reminder also contains instructions on how to update your payment details if needed to avoid any disruptions to your service.
faqs.what_happens_if_a_payment_fails_3b5c45a1: What happens if a payment fails?
faqs.if_a_payment_fails_you_will_receive_an_i:
If a payment fails, you will receive an immediate email notification and see an alert on your account page. The alert provides details on why the payment failed (such as insufficient funds, expired card, or other issues) and offers a link to retry the payment. We allow you a grace period of up to 7 days to resolve the issue. During this time, you can update your payment information or contact your bank to ensure that funds are available.

Additionally, we may attempt to process the payment again automatically after a few days if the failure was due to a temporary issue, such as a network disruption or a brief system error. If the payment issue persists beyond the grace period, your account may be temporarily suspended until the issue is resolved. We will also notify you of any late fees that may apply if the payment remains unresolved. Please ensure that your payment details are up to date to avoid any service disruptions. If you need assistance, our customer support team is available to help you resolve any payment problems.
faqs.yes_auto_renewal_is_available_for_all_pl:
Yes, auto-renewal is available for all plans. To enable auto-renewal, visit your Billing section and check the option for automatic renewal. This ensures that your subscription is renewed automatically using the payment method stored in your account. The auto-renewal process begins at the end of each billing cycle, preventing service interruptions and making sure you don’t miss out on any features. If you want to disable auto-renewal at any time, you can easily do so by updating your subscription settings in the Billing section. You’ll still have access to your service until the end of the current billing period, and once the period ends, you will no longer be charged, and your account will be downgraded or suspended according to your plan’s terms.

Auto-renewal provides convenience and saves you time, so you don’t have to manually renew your subscription each time. Your account will remain active without needing to remember renewal dates. Additionally, auto-renewal guarantees that you will continue receiving any updates, new features, or improvements to the service as they are rolled out. If you have any questions or concerns about the renewal process, our support team is available to assist and clarify any details.
faqs.how_can_i_view_my_billing_history_603337: How can I view my billing history?
faqs.to_view_your_billing_history_navigate_to: To view your billing history, navigate to the Billing section of your account. You’ll find a list of all past transactions, including details like amounts charged, payment methods used, and the dates of each transaction. This feature helps you track your expenses and maintain accurate financial records. You can also download or print individual invoices for tax or reimbursement purposes. The billing history section is updated regularly and provides a complete record of your account activity, making it easy to review previous payments and manage your financial details.
faqs.is_there_a_late_fee_for_missed_payments_: Is there a late fee for missed payments?
faqs.yes_a_late_fee_may_apply_if_a_payment_is: Yes, a late fee may apply if a payment is missed. However, we provide a grace period to resolve any issues with the payment. Notifications of late fees will appear in your account, along with instructions to update your payment details to avoid penalties and keep your account in good standing.
faqs.can_i_receive_invoices_in_a_specific_cur: Can I receive invoices in a specific currency?
faqs.invoices_are_generally_issued_in_your_ac: Invoices are generally issued in your account’s default currency, but you may request invoices in a different currency depending on the platform. Contact our support team to discuss multi-currency options. They will check whether the platform supports such a feature for your account and guide you through the process. If available, you can update your settings to specify your preferred currency for billing. We understand the importance of receiving invoices in your preferred currency, especially for international customers or businesses that require multi-currency billing for accounting purposes.
faqs.we_accept_a_variety_of_payment_methods_i: We accept a variety of payment methods, including credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), debit cards, and popular online payment platforms like PayPal. You can view and update your primary payment method anytime in the Billing section of your account. The payment methods available to you depend on your location and the country you are based in.
faqs.how_do_i_apply_a_discount_code_1fcd026d: How do I apply a discount code?
faqs.to_apply_a_discount_code_go_to_the_billi:
To apply a discount code, go to the Billing section of your account before making your next payment. Look for the "Discount Code" field and enter the code exactly as it appears. Click "Apply" to apply the discount to your next bill. The discount will then be reflected in the total amount due, reducing your payment. If the discount is successfully applied, the final amount will be updated to include the savings.

Discount codes are typically given during promotional periods or as part of special offers. If you experience any issues with applying your discount code, feel free to contact customer support for assistance. They can ensure the code is valid and applied correctly. In some cases, discount codes may have expiration dates or restrictions, so make sure to use them before the code expires. If your code doesn’t work, double-check that you’ve entered it correctly and that it meets all the applicable terms and conditions. Should you need more details, our team is always ready to help clarify any concerns or questions you might have about using discount codes.
faqs.how_do_i_reset_my_password_644ffa3e: How do I reset my password?
faqs.to_reset_your_password_click_the_forgot_: To reset your password, click the “Forgot Password” link on the login page. You will be prompted to enter the email associated with your account. Once submitted, check your inbox for an email with a reset link. Follow the instructions in the email to create a new password. Make sure your new password is unique and secure to keep your account safe. A strong password typically includes a combination of upper and lower case letters, numbers, and symbols.
faqs.yes_you_can_create_multiple_accounts_but: Yes, you can create multiple accounts, but each account requires a unique email address. This allows you to manage different purposes or roles separately, such as one account for personal use and another for business. Each account will have its own settings, billing details, saved preferences, and login credentials. Make sure to keep track of your login details for each account to avoid confusion. Having multiple accounts can help you organize your data and access different features tailored to specific needs. Additionally, each account will remain separate, ensuring that changes or updates to one account will not affect the other.
faqs.how_do_i_delete_my_account_33e3b64a: How do I delete my account?
faqs.to_delete_your_account_navigate_to_the_a:
To delete your account, navigate to the account settings page and click on the “Delete Account” option. You may be prompted to confirm this action, as deleting your account is irreversible. Once confirmed, all your account information, including settings, preferences, and any saved data, will be permanently removed from our system. It’s important to back up any critical data or information before proceeding, as deletion is final, and data cannot be recovered. We recommend exporting any relevant files, such as transaction history, documents, or messages, before you confirm the deletion.

Once your account is deleted, there will be no way to retrieve it or its contents. If you're unsure about deleting your account, you may want to consider deactivating it temporarily instead, which allows you to preserve your data for future use. In the event you change your mind later, deactivation offers a way to re-enable the account without losing any of your stored information. However, deletion is a permanent step and should be taken with careful consideration. Please make sure to review all implications of account deletion before proceeding.
faqs.can_i_change_my_email_address_d25de7da: Can I change my email address?
faqs.yes_you_can_change_your_email_address_fr:
Yes, you can change your email address from the account settings section. Simply go to the “Email” field, enter your new email address, and click “Save” to confirm the change. A confirmation email will be sent to your new email address to verify it. Once you confirm the email, it will become your primary login credential, and you’ll need to use it for future logins. It’s important to make sure the new email address is one that you frequently check for updates and notifications. By updating your email, you ensure that you will continue to receive account notifications, billing information, and other important messages.

Remember, if you ever need to change your email again, the process is simple and can be done directly from the settings page. Having an up-to-date email address is crucial to ensure you're always informed about changes to your account or important alerts, such as payment reminders, service updates, or security notifications. If you encounter any issues when updating your email, our support team is available to assist you with the process and ensure everything goes smoothly.
faqs.yes_two_factor_authentication_2fa_is_ava:
Yes, two-factor authentication (2FA) is available and can be enabled from your account’s security settings. 2FA adds an additional layer of security by requiring a second form of verification, typically sent to your mobile device, in addition to your regular password. This greatly reduces the risk of unauthorized access to your account. Even if someone else manages to obtain your password, they won’t be able to log in without the second authentication factor. It’s an important step in securing your personal information and protecting your account from potential threats.

To enable 2FA, go to your account settings and select the security tab, where you’ll find the option to activate two-factor authentication. Once enabled, you’ll be prompted to enter a code sent to your mobile device each time you log in, providing extra protection. We recommend enabling 2FA for all accounts to help prevent unauthorized access and enhance your online security. It’s a quick setup that ensures your account stays safe from hackers, providing you with peace of mind knowing that your personal information is secure.
faqs.we_implement_strong_encryption_both_in_t: We implement strong encryption (both in transit and at rest), multi-layer firewalls, and continuous monitoring to safeguard your data against unauthorized access.
faqs.do_you_comply_with_gdpr_and_hipaa_9c9363: Do you comply with GDPR and HIPAA?
faqs.yes_our_platform_is_fully_compliant_with: Yes, our platform is fully compliant with GDPR and HIPAA regulations. We regularly undergo audits to ensure compliance with global data protection standards.
faqs.can_i_set_role_based_access_controls_647: Can I set role-based access controls?
faqs.yes_administrators_can_assign_different_: Yes, administrators can assign different access levels to team members. Permissions can be customized to restrict sensitive data access only to authorized users.
faqs.do_you_perform_regular_security_audits_6: Do you perform regular security audits?
faqs.yes_we_perform_internal_and_external_aud: Yes, we perform internal and external audits regularly, as well as penetration testing to identify and resolve vulnerabilities proactively.
faqs.absolutely_mfa_can_be_enabled_for_all_ac: Absolutely. MFA can be enabled for all accounts to add an extra layer of security beyond just usernames and passwords.
faqs.you_can_reach_support_through_email_live: You can reach support through email, live chat, or by submitting a ticket in your dashboard. Our team is available 24/7 to assist you.
faqs.yes_premium_plans_include_priority_suppo: Yes, premium plans include priority support with faster response times and direct access to senior support agents.
faqs.where_can_i_find_tutorials_or_documentat: Where can I find tutorials or documentation?
faqs.all_guides_faqs_and_tutorials_are_availa: All guides, FAQs, and tutorials are available in our Help Center. You can access it anytime from your dashboard.
faqs.what_is_the_typical_response_time_310903: What is the typical response time?
faqs.response_times_vary_by_plan_standard_sup: Response times vary by plan. Standard support typically responds within 24 hours, while priority support users receive responses within 2–4 hours.
faqs.can_i_track_my_support_tickets_7f4dff84: Can I track my support tickets?
faqs.yes_all_submitted_tickets_can_be_tracked: Yes, all submitted tickets can be tracked within your dashboard. You’ll see updates, responses, and estimated resolution times in real time.
faqs.how_do_i_add_new_team_members_53a5b2fe: How do I add new team members?
faqs.to_add_a_new_user_go_to_the_users_teams_: To add a new user, go to the Users & Teams section in your dashboard, click “Add Member,” and assign them a role with the appropriate permissions.
faqs.roles_include_admin_manager_and_member_a: Roles include Admin, Manager, and Member. Admins have full access, Managers have limited administrative controls, and Members have standard access.
faqs.yes_admins_can_configure_custom_permissi: Yes, admins can configure custom permissions to restrict or grant access to specific features, ensuring flexibility for your organization’s needs.
faqs.is_there_a_limit_to_the_number_of_team_m: Is there a limit to the number of team members?
faqs.no_our_platform_supports_unlimited_team_: No, our platform supports unlimited team members. Pricing may vary based on the number of active users under your subscription plan.
faqs.can_i_remove_or_deactivate_users_44c7cdd: Can I remove or deactivate users?
faqs.yes_users_can_be_deactivated_or_permanen: Yes, users can be deactivated or permanently removed at any time through the Users & Teams dashboard. Deactivation retains historical data while restricting login access.
faqs.our_analytics_dashboard_includes_kpis_li: Our analytics dashboard includes KPIs like active users, engagement rates, conversion funnels, and revenue metrics, updated in real time.
faqs.yes_reports_can_be_exported_in_pdf_csv_o: Yes, reports can be exported in PDF, CSV, or Excel formats for offline use or integration with external tools.
faqs.yes_you_can_create_custom_dashboards_by_: Yes, you can create custom dashboards by selecting widgets, KPIs, and data sources relevant to your business goals.
faqs.yes_real_time_data_updates_allow_you_to_: Yes, real-time data updates allow you to monitor performance instantly, enabling faster decision-making for critical campaigns.
faqs.yes_you_can_schedule_automated_report_de: Yes, you can schedule automated report deliveries on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis to your email or team workspace.
faqs.do_you_integrate_with_bi_tools_8c79524f: Do you integrate with BI tools?
faqs.yes_our_analytics_can_integrate_with_too: Yes, our analytics can integrate with tools like Tableau, Power BI, and Google Data Studio for advanced visualizations and analysis.
